annotations.title: Computed VWAP, RSI, EMA, MACD technical indicators

description: Compute historical OHLCV price candles and technical indicators (RSI-14, EMA, MACD, Bollinger Bands, volatility) for a DEX token pool. Pass `chain` (e.g. `base`, `solana`, `ethereum`), token or pool `address`, and optional `timeframe` (`5m`, `15m`, `1h`, `4h`, `1d`; default `1h`). Returns `candles[]` (OHLCV), `rsi_14`, `macd`, `ema`, and `trend_signal`. Do not use for contract security audits (use check_evm_token_risk or check_solana_token_risk). 1 free try per IP, then HTTP 402 ($0.002 USDC).

chain.description: Network: base, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, solana

session_token.description: Optional prepaid x402s_... session token from open_agent_session or https://apix402data.com/pay used after the 1 free try rolls over to HTTP 402.

timeout_ms.description: Optional deadline in ms. If the local LLM would exceed it, the response comes back fast with "degraded": true and non-LLM/cached data

token.description: Token address or symbol (or pool address)

name: get_token_ohlc_indicators
title: Computed VWAP, RSI, EMA, MACD technical indicators
